technologies.name: Non-Standard Archaeologist Safety Gear
technologies.description: Allowing your archaeologists to chose their own gear and protection based on the site they are exploring gives the best chance of success!

technologies.name: Triple Probe Search Patterns
technologies.description: Utilising an optimised search pattern involving three probes simultaneously vastly increases our ability to scan the surfaces of worlds.

technologies.name: Energy Recycling Conduits
technologies.description: New thermal recycling systems in energy conduits allow for more efficient power transfer. Unfortunately this new technology works best in vacuum environments and are very fragile so they are best suited for stationary designs.

technologies.name: Energy Field Theories
technologies.description: New theories on energy fields will have a positive effect on our ability to generate energy.

technologies.name: Non-Emissive Observation Stations
technologies.description: A special coating of ultra-black radio-frequency absorbing material renders our observation station and satellites virtually invisible.

technologies.name: Deep Space Signal Boosters
technologies.description: Self-Powered deep space satellites act as a boosting system for long range communication. These boosters allow for far more efficient planning over long distances.

technologies.name: Inspiring Designs
technologies.description: Highly cost-efficient and beautiful architectural designs .

technologies.name: Algorithmic Planning
technologies.description: Seemingly complex city planning created by advanced algorithms.

technologies.name: Fractal Manufacturing
technologies.description: Using new manufacturing techniques to print smaller components with fractal meshes allows us to save on materials.

technologies.name: Rapid Exchange Units
technologies.description: Tiny robotic arms, fitted with their own basic-AI units, allow for much more efficient exchanging of components with far less material waste.

technologies.name: Quantum Predictive Algorithms
technologies.description: Specialised quantum computer-chips are much more efficient in predicting where a target will be.

technologies.name: Aerogel Cooling Plating
technologies.description: Special carbon aerogel plating can be applied to our weapon systems allowing them to fire more rapid without causing internal damage from overheating.

technologies.name: Portable Forcefields
technologies.description: Advanced forcefield emitters allow for them to be much more easily deployed.

technologies.name: Defensive Experience
technologies.description: The vast defensive lines and bunkers found on the precursor world allow for much more intense and realistic combat training. Expertise on assaulting defensive positions as well as protecting defensive positions is quickly gained.

technologies.name: Mining Mechs
technologies.description: Small mechs fitted with two high-powered mining drills can cut through any type of rock they encounter.

technologies.name: Autonomous Reload Arms
technologies.description: Tiny autonomous robotic arms quickly reload the small self-defence systems of our ships.

technologies.name: Shield Frequency Modulators
technologies.description: Specialised modulators create waves in our shields giving them extra strength against direct impacts.

technologies.name: Wide-Channel Shield Conduits
technologies.description: Large open channel conduits allow for vastly more power to run through the shield emitters, causing our shields to regain strength faster.

technologies.name: Gravity Anchors
technologies.description: Gravitational anchors reduce the amount of stress structures experience from their own weight. They allow for much taller and wider structures to be build.

technologies.name: Micro Gravity Fields
technologies.description: Small emitters produce a localised anti-gravity field which allows structures to have far extruding platforms and sections without collapsing.

technologies.name: Bureaucratic Protocols
technologies.description: Standardised efficient protocols allow for decisions to go through a governance system faster then before.

technologies.name: Diplomatic Appeasement Techniques
technologies.description: Through genuine interest or not, we can reduce the perceived threat to our neighbours by acting slightly condescending. A diplomatic technique that just works universally. We are perceived as the parent, rather than the aggressive sibling.

technologies.name: Time-Crystal Storage
technologies.description: Artificial Time-Crystals do not degrade and can be used to store vast amounts of knowledge. All the knowledge and instructions a new colony could need to grown and expand.

technologies.name: Deep-Space Relay Stations
technologies.description: Efficient and self-powered relay stations to boost signals coming from the borders of our empire.

technologies.name: Master-Database
technologies.description: Specialised Database containing the entirety of our empires scientific knowledge. Specialised algorithms to look up data makes it easier to cross-reference scientific information.

technologies.name: Personal Singularity Assistant
technologies.description: A miniatures simple version of the singularity drive is used as a personal assistant. Though simple in form the personal drive can calculate extremely complex tasks if asked.

technologies.name: Orbital Camouflage
technologies.description: A unique way of constructing buildings using various angles and colours based on the surroundings of structures can make them very difficult to see from orbit.

technologies.name: Polar Garrisons
technologies.description: Insight into precursor warfare leads us to believe polar invasions is a much more common strategy than we first thought.

technologies.name: Drone Watchers
technologies.description: Tiny drones that patrol the streets, much like their immobile static variant: the traffic camera.

technologies.name: Prison Planet Propaganda
technologies.description: A stark reminder that prison planets are not a fun time. Fear of being shipped to one is enough to keep most citizens in line.

technologies.name: Mineral Sensor Field
technologies.description: Sensor field capable of finding even the smallest and deepest veins of minerals.

technologies.name: Tunnelling Nanites
technologies.description: Tiny machines designed to dig deep tunnels towards mineral veins. These automated machines construct highly complex and strong tunnels capable of going deeper than ever before.

technologies.name: Cold Foundries
technologies.description: High-pressure cryosystems are embedded in our alloy forges allowing them to cast hot metal in rapid succession.

technologies.name: Zero-G Belts
technologies.description: Anti-gravity fields can carry materials and finished produces from one part of the factory to the other in any direction without the need of physical installations. Multiple production chains can be fitted in a very small space.

technologies.name: Artifact Emissions
technologies.description: Discovery of unique subspace emissions coming from these artifacts allows us to detect them from large distances away. The galaxy is full of them, we just have to pick them up!

technologies.name: Ancient Vault Treasure Map
technologies.description: Hidden in a compartment of one of the artifacts found was a map. A map leading to a hidden vault within our territories on an ancient moon. Expeditions have already be sent out.

technologies.name: Self-Assembly Starbase Modules
technologies.description: Highly modular systems allow starbases to cheaply change their configurations.

technologies.name: Starbase Heat Recycling
technologies.description: Vast network of thermal transfer nodes allow the starbase to efficiently recyle waste heat.

technologies.name: Plasma Rifles
technologies.description: Soldiers equipped with plasma rifles fire a beam of plasma, which is an excited state of matter consisting of atomic electrons & nuclei and free electrons, causing unprecedented damage to whatever they hit.

technologies.name: Dark-Matter Firearms
technologies.description: "Dark-Matter's unique scientific properties are not only useful for research. Put into ammo these exotic particles become extremely explosive, instantly vaporising into a cloud of super-heated gas and destroying everything in a relativly large radius. Being on the receiving end of a dark-matter is the most frightening experience a soldier will ever have, albeit briefly.

technologies.name: Subspace Sensors
technologies.description: Sensors capable of peering into subspace can detect the warp signatures of ships further away then conventional sensors.

technologies.name: Command Outposts
technologies.description: Specialises military command outposts allow for fleets to better coordinate with central command. As a result, committing more assets to the front lines becomes a lot easier.

technologies.name: Auto Fisheries
technologies.description: Automated harbour fisheries provide an endless supply of food without negatively effecting the environment.

technologies.name: Nanite Fluid Filters
technologies.description: Energetic fluid filters that pull fluids through their nanite latices creating drinkable liquids.

technologies.name: Precursor Theories
technologies.description: A vast databank of precursor gained knowledge will help us out with newer discoveries.

technologies.name: Fast And Loose
technologies.description: Disregarding some complex guidelines when exploring for ancient relics is necessary to beat our rivals to discoveries.

technologies.name: Terraforming Obelisk
technologies.description: Piecing together broken artifacts has lead us to the discovery of it's primary use. It was a terraforming obelisk. A tall building designed to filter, heat, and spread various gases and fluids over an area of a planet in order to terraform it.

technologies.name: A.I. Personal Device
technologies.description: One of the artifacts analysed by our chief scientist is a small obelisk, roughly the size of a cup. It's primary purpose seems to be to assist in calculating complex problems that were imputed.

technologies.name: Core Fluid Dynamics
technologies.description: A better understanding of the convection currents around the planet's core greatly benefits our capacity to terraform.

technologies.name: Volcanic Creation
technologies.description: Terraforming theory about the creation of artificial volcanoes on strategic locations to trigger a temporary global winter. Trapping particles in the atmosphere and heating the planet up can drastically reducing the energy requirements to terraform a world.

technologies.name: Climate Theories
technologies.description: Studying the many different climates on the discovered gaia world has lead to some interesting theories on the existence of exotic climates. This knowledge will greatly benefit our ability adapt to our environments.

technologies.name: Indestructible Beans
technologies.description: Discovery of a new type of bean that can grow almost anywhere and has a high nutritional content. This new food will greatly benefit our ability to feed our colonies.

technologies.name: Elder Envy
technologies.description: The discovery of the holy signals on the recently discovered gaia world has given our government the push it needed to fund scientific research in all areas. We must discover and match these ancient empires.

technologies.name: Existential Counselling
technologies.description: The news that there are ancient elder civilisations in our galaxy has shaken our society. Counselling is best offered to help our people with this existential dread.

technologies.name: Anti-Gravity Boosters
technologies.description: The discovery of artificial anti-gravity boosters gives us unique insights into the nature of artificial gravity.

technologies.name: Gravitational Ejectors
technologies.description: The anti-gravity injector system creates a strong gravitational push on loaded projectiles allowing them to be fired at much higher velocities.

technologies.name: Speeder Tactics
technologies.description: Studying the ancient battlefields have revealed that the use of fast speeder or bike units to flank positions still has great value in modern warfare.

technologies.name: Supply-Line Sabotage
technologies.description: Studies have shown that sabotaging supply-lines have a much more detrimental effect on enemy morale than disrupting them or destroying them.

technologies.name: Standard Compartment Templates
technologies.description: Standard construction templates for ship sections greatly reduces their fabrication cost over time.

technologies.name: Superstructure Bulkheads
technologies.description: Extremely dense bulkheads line every compartment of our ships making them much more resilient to physical stresses.

technologies.name: Self Replication
technologies.description: Carefully controlled nanites are allowed to replicate themselves, giving us an infinite supply of nanites to be used elsewhere.

technologies.name: Nanite Coolant
technologies.description: Nanite coolant is capable of keeping itself cold, so cold it can stay near sub-zero temperatures forever. It does this by actively transferring heat from it's environment and retaining that heat in hyper-efficient thermal cells.

technologies.name: Pleasure Droids
technologies.description: While not officially supported, pleasure droids are so widespread they are impossible to forbid at this point. A thriving black market has resulted in one being in nearly every home, though none would admit to owning one.

technologies.name: Droid Servants
technologies.description: Uniquely docile and suggestive AI are used to construct the best personal servants the galaxy has ever seen.

technologies.name: Archaeological Seeker Drone
technologies.description: Model 32-B-Short-Round is a highly adaptive and reliable drone capable of seeking out unnatural items in the most dangerous and inaccessible places.

technologies.name: Archaeological AI
technologies.description: Specialised constructed AI to assist in analysing the multitude of clues found on digs.

technologies.name: Crystal Growth Catalysts
technologies.description: A combination of exotic chemicals that greatly increase the growth-rate of artificially created crystal structures.

technologies.name: Fractal Refraction
technologies.description: Artificial crystals with an infinite fractal pattern are the absolute best way to focus energy at a target by means of refraction.

technologies.name: Plasma Fields
technologies.description: By creating a stable plasma field around weapon's fire we can ensure they have a higher probability of penetrating armour.

technologies.name: Radon Plasma Manufacturing
technologies.description: Using radon gas, a highly stable and non-reactant material, and super heating it to plasma has remarkable applications in the manufacturing areas of non-stable elements.

technologies.name: Ritual Of Insight
technologies.description: An ancient scroll speaks of a ritual that gives insights into the very nature of the universe..

technologies.name: Ritual Of Sacrifice
technologies.description: An ancient scroll speaks of a ritual that prolongs life.. at a cost.

technologies.name: Alien Fruits
technologies.description: Fast growing exotic trees that produce succulent juicy orange fruits ready to eat.

technologies.name: Healing Flowers
technologies.description: Otherworldly flowers with remarkable healing properties. These flowers are incredible delicate and require permanent care to grow and harvest.

technologies.name: Self-Regenerating Slime
technologies.description: A thin living slime layer can be applied around any material to give it a self-repairing protective layer. This slime is increadably hardy and can survive the harsh conditions of space.

technologies.name: Gas Pods
technologies.description: Biological growths that periodically produce a rare stable gas as a by-product of their metabolism.

technologies.name: Arachnid DNA
technologies.description: What could possibly go wrong cloning some ancient predator.

technologies.name: Pack Behaviour Studies
technologies.description: Unique insights into pack behaviour of arachnids have lead to some interesting new methodologies for studying other species.

technologies.name: Dense Exoscales
technologies.description: Giant scales periodically Shedd from the recently discovered giant worms can be used to reinforce the weaker spots in the armour of our ships.

technologies.name: Mining Worms
technologies.description: Domesticated giant worms can be used to dig massive tunnels. These worms are brought to our colonies when they are still in their eggs. Careful nurturing is key in making sure they only dig where we want them to dig.

technologies.name: Ethics Education
technologies.description: The discovery of the planet full of bones has cause quite a stir in all layers of our society. To prevent ourselves ever getting into a situation that could result into such horror we have introduced permanent and highly focused ethics teachings. We must never make the same mistakes that were made on the planet of bones.

technologies.name: Collateral Dread
technologies.description: Fear of causing mass deaths and collateral damage just to strike an enemy target have led to incredibly smart ammunitions and weapon systems. Strike hard, strike accurate and strike only the enemy!

technologies.name: Incubation
technologies.description: Careful management of the eggs that were found allows us to grow more of these creatures.

technologies.name: Private Benefactors
technologies.description: Some discoveries are so unique and interesting that they practically invite private investors.

technologies.name: Shroom For The Dead
technologies.description: Giant Mushroom forests are the ideal place to get rid of the dead. The rate at which these large fungals eat the corpses is unprecedented and makes disposing of them a safe and environmentally friendly option.

technologies.name: Blue Fungal
technologies.description: A strange blue mushroom has been discovered to have unique virile boosting properties. Above all they appear to be highly addictive and wanted amongst the population.

technologies.name: Manufacuring Maximization
technologies.description: Integrating some automation in the decision making process of manufacturing is bound to have a positive effect.

technologies.name: Lossless Ship Relays
technologies.description: Understanding the energy states of precursor relay grids is a difficult task, but a worthwhile one.

technologies.name: Matrix Duplication
technologies.description: We know how to copy its design and materials, but we don't know how it works exactly. By duplicating the matrix and copying over the energy state we can effectively create more.

technologies.name: Ringworld Psionic Forcefields
technologies.description: The Ringworld decision Psionic Forcefields adds the ringworld modifier Psionic Forcefield increasing pop hapiness and reduces colony bombardment damage.

technologies.description: The Ringworld decision Embeded Neural Nexus adds the ringworld modifier Neural Nexus increasing pop research production.

technologies.description: The Ringworld decision Idyllic Garden Sectors adds the ringworld modifier Idyllic Gardens increasing pop unity production and reducing pop ameneties usage.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Ringworld Xeno Wildlife Preserves
technologies.description: The Ringworld decision Xeno Wildlife Preserves adds the ringworld modifier Xeno Wildlife Preserve allowing the construction of additional xeno zoos and increases culture workers output.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Ringworld Simulator Sectors
technologies.description: The Ringworld decision Simulator Sectors adds the ringworld modifier Battle Simulators increasing ringworld army training speed and adds soldier jobs

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Ringworld Vast oceans
technologies.description: The Ringworld decision Vast oceans adds the ringworld modifier Endless Ocean which makes farmer produce some unity and increases farmer food production.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Ringworld Mass Transit System
technologies.description: The Ringworld decision Mass Transit System adds the ringworld modifier Mass Transit System reducing the upkeep cost of pops.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Flood Management
technologies.description: Flood management strategies generally involve multiple engineering projects that can fall under one of two categories. Hard engineering projects are ones that involve the construction of artificial structures that, through a combination of science, technology and a bit of brute force, prevent a river from flooding. Soft engineering projects are the opposite. These projects use natural resources and local people's knowledge of the river to reduce the risk posed by a flood.

technologies.name: Natural Predators
technologies.description: By introducing harmless natural predators into the environment we should be able to control the locust swarms. We are fairly sure nothing can go wrong with this plan.

technologies.name: Aero-Chemical Neutralisers
technologies.description: It is going to be hard to remove toxic gas clouds that roam the landscape. Our best bet is dropping a mist of chemical neutralisers over them.

technologies.name: Precursor Studies
technologies.description: Enhanced research methodologies for to the collecting and understading of precursor technolgies.

technologies.name: Autonomous Maintanance Bay
technologies.description: Autonomous maintanance bay allowing faster deployment of strike craft. Improved maintenance protocols allow your strike craft to be more efficient in combat.

technologies.name: Chrono-Refractive Matrix
technologies.description: Improves ship accuracy on larger targets by predicting the effects of fire in the immediate future using an enigmatic chrono-algorithm.
